FwupBlock.description: One 8-byte block of firmware transfer data as two 32-bit words, as the frame handler mcu_0160_0800672c stores it. Used for the previous and the current block of the transfer (protocol_fwup_prev_block at 0x200006D4 and protocol_fwup_cur_block at 0x200006DC).

fields.name: word0
fields.description: First four bytes of the block, in the frame's byte order. Holds the raw (still encrypted) data when the block is stored.

fields.name: word1
fields.description: Last four bytes of the block, in the frame's byte order. Holds the raw (still encrypted) data when the block is stored.
